LanguageData.RatkinQL_VeteranTree_Report: A tipsy old soldier stopped by to share a drink and a story.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Veteran_Greeting: Face flushed, he claps your shoulder with a leathery paw. “{Interviewer_labelShort}! Sit down, have a drink with me. I’ll tell you about the good old days—the bloody ones.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Veteran_OptDrink: Buy him a drink and listen to his tales (10 silver)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Veteran_OptStory: Ask him what battles he fought.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Veteran_War1: “I held the Stonebridge for three hours with six rats. The Warlord’s men came three times. They never crossed.” He stares into his cup.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Veteran_War2: “Met a Warlord once, face to face. He took my ear with a sabre. I took his horse.” He grins, toothy and crooked.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Veteran_War3: “Whole platoon—eighteen of us—went into that ravine. Only the rain came out with me. Some days I still hear their voices when it pours.” He falls silent.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Veteran_Farewell: He raises his empty cup in a toast, then sets it down and shuffles away.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Veteran_MsgDrink: You clink cups. He talks with wild gestures, pats your back like an old comrade, and for a moment the years melt away.
